## Activity

For March 2024, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 117 captures. This is the activity total for the reporting month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures below. The figure reflects the captures recorded at the site during the period covered by this report.

## Image quality

Of the recorded captures, 8 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 6.8. This measure identifies the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading and should be considered alongside the overall activity volume. The result provides a clear summary of image usability for the month.

## Grading

A total of 15 results were graded as referable. The median grading lag was 2. This indicates the midpoint for the time taken to complete grading during March 2024. Together, the referable total and median lag summarise the grading outcome and timeliness recorded for Hill Counties Health Centre.
